millArchitectures.name: Industrial Continuous Toothed Rotor-Stator Colloid Mill (5,000 kg/hr, Water-Cooled Stator Jacket, Double Balanced Mechanical Seal)
millArchitectures.classification: Large-Scale Continuous Food Emulsification & Wet Milling (3-A 36-01, EHEDG Class I & FDA 21 CFR 110)
millArchitectures.sealType: Pressurized Double Cartridge Mechanical Seal with Barrier Water Quench (Silicon Carbide vs Tungsten Carbide)
millArchitectures.cipRating: 3-A Sanitary Standard 36-01 Certified Automated CIP/SIP (Ra <= 0.4 um Electro-Polished 316L)
millArchitectures.description: Heavy-duty continuous sanitary colloid mill designed for continuous high-throughput food emulsification, pureeing, and wet micro-milling. Features concentric precision-machined stepped toothed shear rings that progressively accelerate and homogenize fluids. Stator housing incorporates a multi-pass spiral water jacket that removes up to 28 kW of viscous shear dissipation heat, while a pressurized dual mechanical face seal prevents product leakage and seal face thermal vaporization.

millArchitectures.name: Sanitary Conical Micro-Gap Colloid Mill (1,200 kg/hr, Micrometer Gap Adjustment, Thermally Balanced SiC Seal)
millArchitectures.classification: Specialty Emulsion & Fine Nut Paste Processing (3-A Sanitary Standard & USDA Dairy Accepted)
millArchitectures.sealType: Single Sanitary Balanced Mechanical Seal with Steam/Water Barrier Flush (Silicon Carbide vs Silicon Carbide)
millArchitectures.cipRating: EHEDG Document 8 Certified CIP/SIP Ready (Ra <= 0.8 um 316L Stainless Steel)
millArchitectures.description: High-precision conical rotor-stator colloid mill engineered for sub-micron droplet emulsions, mayonnaise production, and fine nut butter refining. Features an external calibrated micrometer handwheel with digital dial gauge for micro-gap adjustment during active operation. Dual-direction cooling jacket regulates shear zone temperature, while hygienic self-draining seal housing prevents product stagnation and bacterial biofilm colonization.

millArchitectures.name: Artisan Corundum Stone Colloid Mill (300 kg/hr, Natural Abrasive Stone Disks, Manual Belt Drive)
millArchitectures.classification: Traditional Stone-Ground Paste & Artisan Sauce Processing (Medium Shear & Uncooled Thermal Creep)
millArchitectures.sealType: Food-Grade Lip Packing Gland with Sanitary Virgin PTFE Packing Rings
millArchitectures.cipRating: Manual Clean-Out-Of-Place (COP) Required (Porosity of abrasive stone surfaces prevents in-situ chemical CIP)
millArchitectures.description: Artisan wet-milling stone mill utilizing synthetic corundum or natural granite abrasive rotor-stator disks for authentic stone-ground texture in tahini, mustard, and nut butters. Lacks an active liquid cooling jacket, relying solely on natural ambient convection and product flow for thermal dissipation. High operational risk of product scorching and accelerated seal gland packing wear during prolonged continuous runs.

millArchitectures.name: Aging Legacy Colloid Mill (Worn Rotor Teeth, Eccentric Gap Runout, Carbonized Uncooled Seal)
millArchitectures.classification: Critical Non-Compliant High-Risk Operation (Severe Viscous Overheating, Seal Leakage & Metal Spalling)
millArchitectures.sealType: Degraded Single Mechanical Seal with Blistered Carbon Faces and Scorched Elastomer O-Rings
millArchitectures.cipRating: Non-Compliant (Severe internal cavitation pitting, tooth edge micro-fractures, and microbial harboring crevices)
millArchitectures.description: Legacy commercial colloid mill suffering from mechanical bearing wear, eccentric rotor shaft deflection (>60 um runout), and calcified cooling jacket passages. Micro-gap unevenness leads to periodic metal-to-metal rubbing, generating microscopic stainless steel particulate contamination, while charred mechanical face seals leak unpasteurized product into motor housings and fail standard swab hygiene audits.

commodityProfiles.name: Roasted Peanut Butter & Tree Nut Paste (High-Fat Non-Newtonian Suspension)
commodityProfiles.description: Dense high-solids suspension of roasted nut lipids and ground cotyledon fibers. Highly pseudoplastic (shear-thinning). Excessive shear dissipation without active jacket cooling elevates exit temperature above 68°C, vaporizing delicate roasty pyrazines and catalyzing rapid lipid autoxidation that degrades shelf-life.

commodityProfiles.name: Commercial Mayonnaise & Dressing Emulsion (High-Internal-Phase 78% Oil Emulsion)
commodityProfiles.description: Oil-in-water emulsion stabilized by egg yolk low-density lipoproteins (LDL) and lecithin. Requires micro-scale shear to break soybean oil into uniform sub-3-micron droplets. If shear-induced friction heats the emulsion beyond 52°C, egg proteins denature thermally, destroying the interfacial film and triggering catastrophic emulsion breaking (oil phase separation).

commodityProfiles.name: Oat, Almond & Soy Plant-Based Milk (Aqueous Colloidal Beverage Base)
commodityProfiles.description: Aqueous colloidal suspension containing hydrated starch, insoluble seed coat celluloses, and globular proteins. Micro-milling reduces gritty particles below 12 microns to eliminate mouthfeel chalkiness. Excess temperature (>78°C) causes premature starch gelatinization and thermal protein flocculation.

commodityProfiles.name: Hot Chili Sriracha Paste & Whole Seed Mustard (Fibrous Acidic Suspension pH 3.3)
commodityProfiles.description: Fibrous, low-pH suspension of chili pepper skins, seeds, vinegar, and natural gums. Highly corrosive to non-passivated metallurgy. High shear homogenizes tough cellulose skins, but friction overheating above 64°C volatilizes volatile allyl isothiocyanates and capsaicinoids while degrading pectin thickeners.
